# Guy de Faye

Guy de Faye is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2002.

Guy de Faye has participated in 10 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye#e2)

  Not elected.
- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 3 & 4 with 54.5% of the ballot.

  Not elected.
